title: Randy Rainbow Slams President Trump’s ‘Corpse-Like Appearance’ in Toe-Tapping ‘Oklahoma!’ Parody
summary: "AI is going to kill us all before Rihanna drops a new album," the comedian laments in a new video.
contentText:
The actual state of Oklahoma may have voted red in the 2026 election, but Randy Rainbow’s spin on the musical Oklahoma! definitely isn’t pro- Donald Trump .

In the singing comedian’s latest parody video posted Thursday (Sept. 24), he reimagines the Rodgers and Hammerstein stage production’s “Surrey With the Fringe on Top” as “Dummy With the Wig on Top,” a song that verbally eviscerates the twice-impeached president’s appearance and mental state. It opens with footage of Trump edited to look as though Rainbow is interviewing him.

“Thanks to your incompetent leadership, eggs are now a luxury item and AI is going to kill us all before Rihanna drops a new album!” the YouTuber “tells” Trump.

It then switches to Rainbow in cowboy garb as he dives into the twangy song. “They ignore his corpse-like appearance/ Scrambled brains and slurred incoherence,” he sings theatrically of JD Vance and other people in Trump’s circle. “He buys votes and rugs both on clearance as his polls kerplop!”

The satirist also roasts the POTUS with lines such as, “Can’t keep up with wars he’s a-startin'” and “His eyes are yeller, his supremacy’s white,” references to the country’s widely protested presence in Iran and the accusations of racism that Trump has faced since the beginning of his political career.

Billboard has reached out to the White House for comment.

Rainbow has a long history of ruthlessly mocking Trump via song. Just a few months prior to his most recent parody, the creator lambasted the billionaire in a Cole Porter spoof titled “He’s De-Mented.”

“It’s clear that Grandpa’s off his pills,” he sang to the jazzy tune in June. “He can hear that bipartisan fear/ They’re united left and right: He’s in decline/ Time to resign.”
